items.text: The Auto Chess Official Server will close matchmaking at 07:00 (UTC+8) on September 23, and will begin server shutdown update maintenance at 08:00 (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to take 4 hours. During maintenance, you will temporarily be unable to log in to the game. The server opening time may be advanced or delayed depending on the actual maintenance progress. Please plan your game time in advance. The details of this update are as follows:
Class: Warlock (Zelatun is not affected by the Warlock class trait)
Battle Cry: A Demon Gate opened by Zelatun continuously summons random Demon pieces with Star Level equal to (Skill Level) until the gate's energy is depleted or it is destroyed.
Obtain 20 Spiral Forgers. Consume (Item Quality) Spiral Forgers to replace an item with a random item of the same quality.

Transforming Common / Uncommon / Rare / Epic / Legendary quality items consumes 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 Spiral Forgers respectively. Spiral Forgers only last for 10 rounds. After the duration ends, based on the remaining number, there is a chance to drop 0-2 Dormant Crystals.
[Wrecking Ball]: Wrecking Ball will not disappear after hitting a target; instead, it will seek a new target until the duration ends, when it returns to the caster and restores HP.

[Eagle Eye]: Other allied Hawks will no longer trigger [Eagle Eye] when casting active skills. That is, when multiple Hawks are on the field at the same time, they will no longer trigger each other's [Eagle Eye] skill.
[Hail of Bullets]: Bonus normal attacks no longer trigger on-hit effects, such as the armor reduction effect from the normal attack of 「Erosion Blade」.
: Illusions now inherit a percentage of the original's current HP. At the same time, Illusions only deal 50% damage; for example, 「Mjollnir」 only deals 100 magic damage.
Clones can no longer be revived by Cave Prodigy.
: The skill now always hits, ignoring the target's Evasion effect.
[Inner Demon]: Mirror pieces now inherit the original's current HP percentage.
[Frost Curse]: Removed the effect where damage dealt by the holder reduces the target's Attack by 50%.
No longer trigger the Shaman Synergy's Hex.
Stacks are now dynamically calculated in real time. When Demon pieces die, are summoned, revived, transformed, or mind-controlled, the stack count will refresh in real time.

Same-name Demons activating pure Demon Synergy: Pieces that activate Demon can stack Demon Power, up to a maximum of 7 stacks. For example, if two Hell Knights activate Demon Synergy at the start, each Hell Knight has 2 stacks of Demon Power. If one dies, it changes to 1 stack.: Demons summoned by Fel Titan will have their stacks calculated separately based on whether they share the same name. For example, if there are two Fel Titans at the start, their Demon Power is 2 stacks. If one Fel Titan is summoned, it becomes 3 stacks. If a Fallen Witcher is summoned, only the number of Fallen Witchers is counted, which is 1 stack.

When both Demon and Witcher Synergies are triggered: All allied Demons and enemy Witchers will be counted toward Demon Power stacks. It is no longer limited to different types of Demons; only the quantity is counted, with a maximum of 7 stacks. The current Demon Power stack count will also be displayed on the Synergy icon.: 2. Witcher: Witchers now interfere with the enemy's Demon synergy count. The specific effect depends on the enemy's Demon and Wizard combination:
If the enemy has not used a Demon-race Wizard to activate Wizard , the Witcher can cause them to additionally trigger Demon Synergy, thereby disrupting the enemy's Wizard synergy;

If the enemy uses a single Demon-race Wizard but cannot activate Wizard due to Demon Synergy interference, the Witcher can also disable the enemy's Demon Synergy, thereby helping them trigger Wizard synergy.: 3. Feathered: Feathered : Illusions will no longer inherit bonuses from non-base stats. For example, the attack damage increased by Vengeful Knight's skill will not be inherited by Illusions.: 4. Shaman: Shaman pieces now inherit the Shaman class trait after transforming.: 5. Knight: The damage reduction shield granted by the class trait lasts 3→4 seconds.: [Combat Adjustments]: 1. Unified Mana Recovery Rules
Mana recovery boost effects now apply to all three Mana gain sources: natural regeneration, recovery from dealing damage, and recovery from taking damage.

Mana recovery reduction effects now apply to all Mana gain sources, including Dragon Synergy, Dragon Horn, etc.: 2. All Battle Cry skills are now only cast once during the Battle Cry phase before combat begins. Pieces that re-enter the battlefield during combat through revival, summoning, rebirth, etc. will no longer trigger Battle Cry skills.: 3. The Hex effect of Defector and Scythe of Vyse will no longer apply repeatedly to pieces that have already been Hexed.: 4. Starting from Round 45, all players will automatically unlock and activate all Talents.: 5. The in-game piece detail panel will now display the piece's actual value.: 6. Summon spawn position priority is adjusted to: Front > Sides > Rear. When space allows, summons will preferentially appear in front of the piece.: [Drodo Fusion]: 1. Brand New Event Now Live! During the event, drag two pieces of the same type and level on the event page to combine them into a higher-level piece. Combined pieces are divided into two categories: Main-line pieces and Side-line pieces.: 2. Once a piece reaches max level, click it to remove it: Removing a max-level Main-line piece grants Battle-Hardened Skin 「Dimension Bunny Girl」 Skin Shards; removing both max-level Main-line and Side-line pieces grants Commemorative Whistles. Commemorative Whistles can be exchanged for rewards in the Shop. The more you remove, the more rewards you get!: 3. Complete Daily Tasks to claim Shell Coins to summon pieces. The first task reward each day is doubled; finishing in the top 4 of Ranked (Solo) / Casual Mode also grants extra Shell Coins!: 1. Added barrage notifications for some Relic effects and the Egersis Pact, while streamlining some barrage messages.: 2. Optimized the Talent button display; you can now quickly view currently active Talents on the button.: 3. Added a data column for damage dealt to the player in the match result screen, and removed the reward column display.: 4. Insurance Card now only takes effect for King 2 and below ranks.: 1. Fixed an issue where Glint Ring's teleport was not restricted by ability range distance. The teleport distance will now be correctly limited to a range of 640.: Above is the main content of this update. If you have any questions, please contact customer service (Home Page-upper right Menu-Support). Thank you for your support.: Auto Chess Operation Team
